article.title: International trade theory not developmental
article.author: Jomo Kwame Sundaram
article.content: Most free trade advocates falsely claim comparative advantage ensures developmental gains for all from trade liberalisation. But even mainstream theory doesn’t promise partial liberalisation is better. The post International trade theory not developmental appeared first on MR Online .
